clue.text: Help a performance by 28 for example

parts.note: to help someone is to aid them

explanation.surface: Someone offers assistance to a show put on by the pub singer.
explanation.walkthrough: 28 is BARITONE: the opera has baritone roles, so it is a performance a baritone might give.
explanation.definitionFit: Verdi's opera is a stage work in which a baritone sings a leading role, so it is one such performance.

clue.text: Views source of tension in official documents

indicators.note: in places the first letter of tension within the travel papers

parts.note: visas are official travel documents stamped in a passport

indicators.note: the source of a word is where it starts, so its first letter is taken

explanation.surface: Opinions on what causes friction in bureaucratic paperwork.
explanation.definitionFit: Vistas are wide scenic outlooks, which are views.

clue.text: Principal religion found in a hotel

indicators.note: found in means the abbreviation for the religion sits inside a and hotel

parts.note: H is hotel in the phonetic alphabet
RC stands for Roman Catholic, a religion

explanation.surface: The main faith is discovered in a hotel.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective, arch means chief or leading, as in an arch-rival.

clue.text: Gone off to stable horse and get a drink

indicators.note: to stable a horse is to house it, so the horse goes inside the shuffled letters
off means gone bad or wrong, so the letters of gone are rearranged

parts.note: GG, short for gee-gee, is a childish word for a horse

explanation.surface: Someone leaves to put a horse in its stall and fetch a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' turns GONE into ENOG; 'to stable' puts GG inside it after the E.
explanation.definitionFit: Eggnog is a festive beverage of milk, egg and often spirits.

clue.text: Religious occasion when one is rumoured to become entirely debilitated

indicators.note: a rumour is hearsay, passed by word of mouth, so the words are judged by how they are heard

parts.note: entirely means wholly and debilitated means weak

explanation.surface: A church festival during which someone is said to fall completely ill.
explanation.definitionFit: The week before Easter is a period of special observance in the Christian calendar.

clue.text: Diplomat who might sob as drama develops

indicators.note: as the drama develops it changes shape, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An envoy who might weep as the play unfolds.
explanation.definitionFit: An ambassador is a senior envoy representing a country abroad.

clue.text: Fashionable in a man of the cloth?

definitions.text: Fashionable in a man of the cloth?

indicators.note: in puts the word for fashionable within the term for a man

parts.note: mister is the title of a man
in means trendy or fashionable

explanation.surface: Is it trendy to be inside a clergyman?
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines: 'man of the cloth' points to a clergyman while 'Fashionable in a man' builds the word.
explanation.definitionFit: A clergyman, especially in Protestant churches, is called a minister.

clue.text: Rants when one is taken in by business deals

indicators.note: taken in by means held inside, so the numeral for one goes within the deals

parts.note: trades are commercial transactions
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Outbursts happen when someone gets swindled in commerce.
explanation.definitionFit: A tirade is a long angry speech, a rant.

clue.text: Their wedding breakfast could be curries!

definitions.text: Their wedding breakfast could be curries!

parts.words: Their wedding breakfast could be curries!
parts.note: the surface imagines spicy dishes at a wedding meal for the men getting married; but to curry a horse is to brush it, so curries is also a synonym for the verb meaning tends a horse's coat

explanation.surface: The bridegrooms might serve spicy dishes at the reception.
explanation.definitionFit: Bridegrooms have a wedding breakfast, and currying a horse means brushing it down, the same as the stable verb.

clue.text: Invest time in one who dislikes top gear producer!

indicators.note: to invest is to clothe or put inside, so time is put within the word for one who dislikes

parts.note: a hater is someone who dislikes

explanation.surface: Put some time into somebody who loathes the TV motoring show.
explanation.walkthrough: Top Gear is a British TV motoring programme; here 'top gear' means headgear.
explanation.definitionFit: A hatter makes hats, which are worn on top of the head.

clue.text: Worker given cards worrying many

parts.note: the set of cards a player holds is a hand

indicators.note: worrying means troubling or disturbing, so the letters of many are shaken up

explanation.surface: An employee who receives a playing hand bothers a lot of people.
explanation.definitionFit: A handyman is a person employed to do odd jobs and repairs.

clue.text: Planners put on shift work?

parts.note: the surface suggests people who draw up work rotas, but a shift is also a simple frock, so these are people who plan garments

explanation.surface: Organisers assigned to work rotating shifts.
explanation.definitionFit: Fashion creators plan frocks, and a shift is a kind of loose frock.

clue.text: Re-establishes check on American territories

parts.note: to rein is to restrain or check
the USA is divided into states

explanation.surface: Restores control over regions of the USA.
explanation.definitionFit: To reinstate is to restore to a former position, re-establishing it.

clue.text: Does it hurt to be stylish?

explanation.surface: Is pain the price of looking good?
explanation.definitionFit: Smart is a verb for stinging pain and an adjective for elegant, well-dressed.

clue.text: One in 1 keen to make a comeback?

indicators.note: making a comeback means coming back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: avid means eager or keen

explanation.surface: A singer in Verdi's opera eager to return to the stage.
explanation.walkthrough: 1 is AIDA, the opera; the lead soprano in it is a prima donna.
explanation.definitionFit: A prima donna is the leading female opera singer, who would sing in that opera.

clue.text: A dish one cooks for firm contact

indicators.note: to cook is also to tamper with or alter, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone prepares a meal for a business acquaintance.
explanation.definitionFit: Adhesion is the action of sticking fast, a firm attachment between surfaces.

clue.text: Rod's 20!

definitions.meaning: 20 is SCHOOLTEACHERS, who make up a school's employees

explanation.surface: A man named Rod is one of the teaching team.
explanation.definitionFit: A staff is a walking stick, and also the collective employees of an organisation such as a school.

clue.text: Oddly, they're after an apartment that's more on the level

indicators.note: after means the odd letters come behind the apartment

parts.note: a flat is an apartment

indicators.note: oddly takes the first, third and fifth letters

explanation.surface: Strange that they want a home that's more level.
explanation.definitionFit: Flatter is the comparative of flat, meaning more even and level.

clue.text: Jokes about 20's charges

definitions.meaning: to kid is to tease or joke
20 is SCHOOLTEACHERS, whose charges are children

explanation.surface: Gags about the pupils in a teacher's care.
explanation.definitionFit: Kids means teases jokingly, and is also informal for children such as pupils.

clue.text: Professional people wanting fish cast here perhaps

parts.note: a school is a group of fish

indicators.note: perhaps suggests these letters may be arranged otherwise

explanation.surface: Anglers lacking fish might cast their lines here.
explanation.definitionFit: Teachers in schools are trained practitioners of a profession.

clue.text: Visual change coral undergoes when fed uranium

indicators.note: being fed means having something put inside, so the uranium symbol goes within
change tells us the letters of coral are altered

parts.note: U is the chemical symbol for uranium

explanation.surface: The visible transformation reefs go through when given nuclear fuel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'change' makes OCLAR from CORAL; 'when fed' puts U inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Ocular means relating to the eye or vision.

clue.text: Landlords accepting one gets lifts

indicators.note: accepting means taking in, so the numeral goes within the landlords

parts.note: landlords of pubs are hosts
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Pub landlords taking in a lodger get raised.
explanation.definitionFit: Hoists means raises or lifts, as with ropes or cranes.

clue.text: Manipulator providing service, energy and function

parts.note: Mass is a church service
E is the abbreviation for energy in physics
use means a purpose or function

explanation.surface: A handler offering service, power and utility.
explanation.definitionFit: A masseuse kneads and manipulates the body's muscles.

clue.text: Able to adapt to a place of exile

indicators.note: to adapt is to alter, so the letters of able are rearranged

explanation.surface: Capable of adjusting to life in banishment.
explanation.definitionFit: Napoleon was banished to the Mediterranean island in 1814.

clue.text: Follow regular tour fashion

parts.note: to tail someone is to follow them

indicators.note: regular means every other letter is taken, here the second and fourth

explanation.surface: Go after a fashion trip on a regular basis.
explanation.definitionFit: To tailor is to shape or adapt, as one fashions a garment.

clue.text: Has some topless evening dresses

indicators.note: topless means the top letter is removed

parts.note: gowns are long formal evening dresses

explanation.surface: Possesses some revealing formal wear.
explanation.definitionFit: To own something is to have or possess it.

clue.text: 10 might make one of a red pattern

indicators.note: a pattern is a design or arrangement, so these letters take a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A milliner might make a red patterned hat.
explanation.definitionFit: A fedora is a soft felt hat with a creased crown, such as a hat-maker produces.

clue.text: Singular quality of sound on pub singer

indicators.note: in an across clue, on means placed after, so the singular and tone pieces follow the pub

parts.note: a bar is a pub
the lone numeral for one, a single unit, stands for singular
tone is a quality of sound

explanation.surface: A distinctive voice in the bar.
explanation.definitionFit: A baritone is a male vocalist with a voice between tenor and bass.
